description: Compares domains competing in search results for a supplied keyword set. Useful for market and search-intelligence reports; not radius-based local SEO. The inverse of get_keyword_gap, which asks what one competitor ranks for that we do not. CHARGES CREDITS ON THE PAID DATA PROVIDER, which is also the only one that honours `resultTypes` and `includeSubdomains` and that measures `visibility`, `etv` and `rating`. On the default free provider competitors are aggregated from one live SERP per keyword: NOTHING IS CHARGED, only ORGANIC results are counted whatever `resultTypes` says, `includeSubdomains` is ignored, and visibility/traffic-estimate/rating are left unmeasured. Sorting never treats an unmeasured field as zero: rows the provider did not measure sort last and are reported in `unmeasuredForSort`. If that count equals the row count, the list is NOT ranked by anything — say so instead of presenting the first row as the strongest competitor. Omit `locationCode`/`languageCode` to use the project's default market.

excludeDomains.description: Domains to exclude from results (e.g. the user's own site).

includeSubdomains.description: Count subdomains as part of the same competitor domain.

languageCode.description: Language code (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr'). Omit it to use the project's default market language, which falls back to 'en'.

limit.description: Maximum competitors to return (1-100). Defaults to 50.

locationCode.description: DataForSEO location code. Omit it to use the project's default market, which falls back to 2840 (United States) for a project that has not set one. See dataforseo.com/help-center/locations. Some countries (e.g. Iceland, 2352) are served from Google Ads data: keyword volume/CPC/trends work, but keyword difficulty, search intent, and domain analytics are unavailable.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

resultTypes.description: SERP result types to include. Defaults to organic and local_pack.

sortBy.description: Sort order for returned competitors. Defaults to visibility. Only `keyword_count` and `avg_position` are measured on every provider — `visibility` and `traffic_estimate` are unmeasured on the free provider, and rows without the chosen field sort last rather than as zero. Prefer `keyword_count` when you need an order that always means something.

name: find_serp_competitors
